revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and a schema-classification error require targeted fixes before shipping: (1) Fix rep_intent.evidence[1] — the quote 'Well, yeah, that's pretty much all the questions we have here for you, Frederick.' is actually at 03:47, not 04:47; correct the timestamp. (2) Fix the duplicate/confusing cherry_pick_moments entry at 01:20 (index 5) — it's redundant with entry [0] and mislabels the adult-child co-owner miss as 'cross_sell_miss', which is schema-inconsistent (cross_sell_signals refers to roofing/battery upsell, not decision-maker inclusion). Either merge this into entry [0] or relabel it as a protocol_adherence gap, and strip the self-referential meta-commentary ('Duplicate flagging intentionally omitted per instructions is not applicable here') which reads as internal reasoning leakage rather than manager-facing analysis. (3) Add a cherry_pick_moments entry for the 00:51 interest-reason moment (price trend + state incentive) since it's a concrete, well-articulated personalization opportunity that only appears buried in the secondary interest_reason_audit field — it deserves visibility alongside the other coaching moments, especially given text_after_call's required tieback element. (4) Optionally credit the rep's positive engagement at 01:38 (roof-pitch acknowledgment) and 08:44 (proactive question-prep prompt) to avoid an overly one-sided negative characterization of the rep's execution — the call is booked cleanly with good structural coverage; the current draft reads more negatively than the transcript supports.
